node_definition.done_when: Per §76 of the plan: the remind cadence re-emits a non-empty needs-you set only; the empty line 'yours: N working · nothing needs you' prints once when the set becomes empty after the pane last showed it non-empty, never on the cadence; the settle line reads 'no live work since HH:MM', naming a session only when the pane also observes another session's work; its tail names the outstanding runs only when they differ from the set the last needs-you line showed, and still reads drained when nothing is outstanding. Fake-clock tests extending tests/test_follow_needs_you_line.py, tests/test_follow_drain_line.py and tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py show every case the section lists (empty set over 35 minutes emits nothing; one-unpromoted-to-empty emits the empty line once then nothing for 35 minutes; a non-empty set unchanged for 25 minutes emits at 10 and 20 minutes; settle line without own session id, with an observed one; tail absent, naming, drained). Every test file under tests/ importing reckon.crew.needs_you or reckon.crew_follow_commands, rebuilt from the head tree, adds no failure against a base arm, both arms from git checkouts under the run's own scratch directory with RECKON_SESSION_HOST_SETTLE, RECKON_FOLLOWER_OWNER, RECKON_FOLLOWER_IMAGE_COMMIT and RECKON_FOLLOWER_SOURCE_ROOT unset, run in place on the fleet node with pytest -n 8; any id failing in one arm only is run five times alone in each arm. tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py passes at head. Every log is under the run directory, starts with its revision and the literal command, and ends in EXIT=. ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the changed files, judged against the base blobs.
